inputs.text: These radical leftists prove once again they cannot stage a protest without it descending into outright lawlessness. Their so-called "No Kings" rally against Trump began by packing the streets but quickly turned volatile, with agitators clashing against federal officers and forcing police to respond with tear gas, arrests, and dispersal orders to restore order. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable outcome when people reject authority, personal responsibility, and the social order that upholds our traditions and national stability.
